```{r data_prep}
# 1) Load trial-level data
raw <- read.csv("Sharing/Learning_all.csv")

# 2) Keep target trials and required columns for BKT, restricted to age-matched IDs
bkt_df <- raw %>%
	filter(Appearing_Sti_type %in% c("TarN", "TarV")) %>%
	transmute(
		id = as.character(Name),
		trial = as.integer(Trial_n),
		correct = as.integer(Correct_or_not)
	) %>%
	filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(trial), !is.na(correct), correct %in% c(0L, 1L)) %>%
	arrange(id, trial) %>%
	group_by(id) %>%
	mutate(trial_index = row_number()) %>%
	ungroup() %>%
	left_join(demo, by = "id")

cat("Age-matched participants used:", dplyr::n_distinct(bkt_df$id), "\n")
cat("Total trials used:", nrow(bkt_df), "\n")
```

```{r stan_data}
# Convert to ragged-per-person sequence format (padded matrix for Stan)
id_levels <- sort(unique(bkt_df$id))
I <- length(id_levels)

split_y <- split(bkt_df$correct, factor(bkt_df$id, levels = id_levels))
T_i <- as.integer(vapply(split_y, length, integer(1)))
max_T <- max(T_i)

y <- matrix(0L, nrow = I, ncol = max_T)
for (i in seq_len(I)) {
	y[i, seq_len(T_i[i])] <- split_y[[i]]
}

stan_data <- list(
	I = I,
	max_T = max_T,
	T_i = T_i,
	y = y
)
```

```{r stan_model}
# Bayesian BKT with forgetting (2 latent states: not-mastered, mastered)
# Transition: not-mastered -> mastered is learning rate T
# mastered -> not-mastered is forgetting rate F
# Emission: slip S, guess G
stan_code <- "
data {
	int<lower=1> I;
	int<lower=1> max_T;
	array[I] int<lower=1> T_i;
	array[I, max_T] int<lower=0, upper=1> y;
}

parameters {
	real mu_logit_L0;
	real<lower=0> sigma_logit_L0;
	vector[I] z_L0;

	real mu_logit_T;
	real<lower=0> sigma_logit_T;
	vector[I] z_T;

	real mu_logit_F;
	real<lower=0> sigma_logit_F;
	vector[I] z_F;

	real mu_logit_G;
	real<lower=0> sigma_logit_G;
	vector[I] z_G;

	real mu_logit_S;
	real<lower=0> sigma_logit_S;
	vector[I] z_S;
}

transformed parameters {
	vector<lower=0, upper=1>[I] L0;
	vector<lower=0, upper=1>[I] learn_rate;
	vector<lower=0, upper=1>[I] forget_rate;
	vector<lower=0, upper=0.30>[I] guess_rate;
	vector<lower=0, upper=0.10>[I] slip_rate;

	L0 = inv_logit(mu_logit_L0 + sigma_logit_L0 * z_L0);
	learn_rate = inv_logit(mu_logit_T + sigma_logit_T * z_T);
	forget_rate = inv_logit(mu_logit_F + sigma_logit_F * z_F);
	guess_rate = 0.3  * inv_logit(mu_logit_G + sigma_logit_G * z_G);
	slip_rate = 0.1 * inv_logit(mu_logit_S + sigma_logit_S * z_S);
}

model {
	mu_logit_L0 ~ normal(-0.5, 0.8);
	sigma_logit_L0 ~ normal(0, 0.4);
	z_L0 ~ normal(0, 1);

	mu_logit_T ~ normal(-1.0, 0.8);
	sigma_logit_T ~ normal(0, 0.4);
	z_T ~ normal(0, 1);

	mu_logit_F ~ normal(-3.0, 0.7);
	sigma_logit_F ~ normal(0, 0.3);
	z_F ~ normal(0, 1);

	mu_logit_G ~ normal(-1.6, 0.8);
	sigma_logit_G ~ normal(0, 0.4);
	z_G ~ normal(0, 1);

	mu_logit_S ~ normal(-1.6, 0.8);
	sigma_logit_S ~ normal(0, 0.4);
	z_S ~ normal(0, 1);

	for (i in 1:I) {
		real pL;
		pL = L0[i];

		for (t in 1:T_i[i]) {
			real p_correct;
			p_correct = pL * (1 - slip_rate[i]) + (1 - pL) * guess_rate[i];
			target += bernoulli_lpmf(y[i, t] | p_correct);

			if (y[i, t] == 1) {
				pL = (pL * (1 - slip_rate[i])) / p_correct;
			} else {
				pL = (pL * slip_rate[i]) / (1 - p_correct);
			}

			pL = pL * (1 - forget_rate[i]) + (1 - pL) * learn_rate[i];
		}
	}
}

generated quantities {
	real pop_L0;
	real pop_learn_rate;
	real pop_forget_rate;
	real pop_guess_rate;
	real pop_slip_rate;

	pop_L0 = inv_logit(mu_logit_L0);
	pop_learn_rate = inv_logit(mu_logit_T);
	pop_forget_rate = inv_logit(mu_logit_F);
	pop_guess_rate = 0.3 * inv_logit(mu_logit_G);
	pop_slip_rate = 0.1 * inv_logit(mu_logit_S);
}
"
```



## BKT subset helper function
```{r fit_bkt_subset_function}
fit_bkt_subset <- function(df_trials, stan_code, seed = 1121,
                           chains = 4, iter = 10000, warmup = 5000) {
	id_levels_sub <- sort(unique(df_trials$id))
	I_sub <- length(id_levels_sub)
	if (I_sub < 2) {
		return(NULL)
	}

	split_y_sub <- split(df_trials$correct, factor(df_trials$id, levels = id_levels_sub))
	T_i_sub <- as.integer(vapply(split_y_sub, length, integer(1)))
	max_T_sub <- max(T_i_sub)

	y_sub <- matrix(0L, nrow = I_sub, ncol = max_T_sub)
	for (i in seq_len(I_sub)) {
		y_sub[i, seq_len(T_i_sub[i])] <- split_y_sub[[i]]
	}

	stan_data_sub <- list(
		I = I_sub,
		max_T = max_T_sub,
		T_i = T_i_sub,
		y = y_sub
	)

	init_fun_sub <- function() {
		list(
			mu_logit_L0 = qlogis(0.35),
			sigma_logit_L0 = 0.15,
			z_L0 = rnorm(I_sub, 0, 0.1),
			mu_logit_T = qlogis(0.20),
			sigma_logit_T = 0.15,
			z_T = rnorm(I_sub, 0, 0.1),
			mu_logit_F = qlogis(0.05),
			sigma_logit_F = 0.10,
			z_F = rnorm(I_sub, 0, 0.1),
			# In the current model, guess_rate = 0.3 * inv_logit(...)
			# and slip_rate = 0.1 * inv_logit(...), so the starting values
			# should correspond to the bounded probabilities, not the raw logit scale.
			mu_logit_G = qlogis(0.12 / 0.30),
			sigma_logit_G = 0.15,
			z_G = rnorm(I_sub, 0, 0.1),
			mu_logit_S = qlogis(0.05 / 0.10),
			sigma_logit_S = 0.12,
			z_S = rnorm(I_sub, 0, 0.1)
		)
	}

	fit_sub <- rstan::stan(
		model_code = stan_code,
		data = stan_data_sub,
		init = init_fun_sub,
		chains = chains,
		iter = iter,
		warmup = warmup,
		seed = seed,
		control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)
	)

	post_sub <- rstan::extract(fit_sub)
	rates_tib <- tibble(
		id = id_levels_sub,
		learn_mean = colMeans(post_sub$learn_rate),
		forget_mean = colMeans(post_sub$forget_rate),
		guess_mean = colMeans(post_sub$guess_rate),
		slip_mean = colMeans(post_sub$slip_rate)
	)

	# Attach the raw stanfit as an attribute so callers can capture it if desired
	attr(rates_tib, "stanfit") <- fit_sub

	return(rates_tib)
}
```


## Switch type BKT analysis: previous trial Event_type to current trial Event_type
```{r switch_type_analysis}
# Define four switch categories from previous to current Event_type.
switch_df <- raw %>%
	filter(Appearing_Sti_type %in% c("TarN", "TarV"), Event_type %in% c("E_High", "E_Low")) %>%
	transmute(
		id = as.character(Name),
		trial = as.integer(Trial_n),
		correct = as.integer(Correct_or_not),
		Event_type = as.character(Event_type)
	) %>%
	filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(trial), !is.na(correct), correct %in% c(0L, 1L)) %>%
	semi_join(demo, by = "id") %>%
	arrange(id, trial) %>%
	group_by(id) %>%
	mutate(
		prev_Event_type = dplyr::lag(Event_type, 1),
		switch_type = dplyr::case_when(
			is.na(prev_Event_type) ~ "Initial",
			prev_Event_type == Event_type & Event_type == "E_High" ~ "E_High_to_E_High",
			prev_Event_type == Event_type & Event_type == "E_Low" ~ "E_Low_to_E_Low",
			prev_Event_type == "E_High" & Event_type == "E_Low" ~ "E_High_to_E_Low",
			prev_Event_type == "E_Low" & Event_type == "E_High" ~ "E_Low_to_E_High",
			TRUE ~ "Other"
		)
	) %>%
	ungroup() %>%
	filter(!switch_type %in% c("Initial", "Other"))

switch_levels <- c("E_High_to_E_High", "E_High_to_E_Low", "E_Low_to_E_High", "E_Low_to_E_Low")

switch_rate_list <- vector("list", length(switch_levels))
names(switch_rate_list) <- switch_levels

# ensure a place to store per-subset stanfit objects for diagnostics
if (!exists("bkt_fit_list")) bkt_fit_list <- list()

for (sw in switch_levels) {
	df_sw <- switch_df %>%
		filter(switch_type == sw) %>%
		arrange(id, trial) %>%
		group_by(id) %>%
		mutate(trial_index = row_number()) %>%
		ungroup()

	cat("\nFitting switch type:", sw,
		"| participants:", dplyr::n_distinct(df_sw$id),
		"| trials:", nrow(df_sw), "\n")

	if (dplyr::n_distinct(df_sw$id) < 2 || nrow(df_sw) < 20) {
		warning(paste("Skip", sw, "because data are too sparse for stable BKT estimation."))
		next
	}

	rate_sw <- fit_bkt_subset(df_sw, stan_code = stan_code,
		seed = 1121 + which(switch_levels == sw),
		chains = 4, iter = 10000, warmup = 5000)

	if (!is.null(rate_sw)) {
		switch_rate_list[[sw]] <- rate_sw %>%
			mutate(switch_type = sw)
		# store underlying stanfit (if attached) for later Rhat checks
		if (!is.null(attr(rate_sw, "stanfit"))) {
			bkt_fit_list[[paste0("switch_", sw)]] <- attr(rate_sw, "stanfit")
		}
	}
}

switch_rates_all <- bind_rows(switch_rate_list) %>%
	left_join(demo, by = "id") %>%
	filter(!is.na(FRD))

cat("\nMatched participants in switch-type output:", nrow(switch_rates_all), "\n")

switch_desc <- switch_rates_all %>%
	group_by(switch_type, FRD) %>%
	summarise(
		n = dplyr::n(),
		learn_m = mean(learn_mean),
		learn_sd = sd(learn_mean),
		forget_m = mean(forget_mean),
		forget_sd = sd(forget_mean),
		guess_m = mean(guess_mean),
		guess_sd = sd(guess_mean),
		slip_m = mean(slip_mean),
		slip_sd = sd(slip_mean),
		.groups = "drop"
	)

print(switch_desc)
write.csv(switch_rates_all, "Sharing/BKT_participant_rates_by_switchtype.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# 汇总并取出 Rhat
```{r rhat_summary}
## Summarise Rhat for any available stanfit objects (main fit and subset fits)

fits <- list()

# 1) any explicit collection created earlier
if (exists("bkt_fit_list") && is.list(bkt_fit_list)) {
	for (nm in names(bkt_fit_list)) {
		if (inherits(bkt_fit_list[[nm]], "stanfit")) fits[[nm]] <- bkt_fit_list[[nm]]
	}
}

# 2) top-level `fit` if present
if (exists("fit") && inherits(fit, "stanfit")) {
	fits[["full_fit"]] <- fit
}

# 3) scan global environment for any other stanfit objects
objs <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)
for (o in objs) {
	obj <- get(o, envir = .GlobalEnv)
	if (inherits(obj, "stanfit") && !(o %in% names(fits))) {
		fits[[o]] <- obj
	}
}

if (length(fits) == 0) {
	cat("No stanfit objects found for Rhat checks. Make sure fits are stored (e.g. in `bkt_fit_list` or `fit`).\n")
} else {
	rhat_dfs <- list()
	for (nm in names(fits)) {
		ssum <- tryCatch(summary(fits[[nm]])$summary, error = function(e) NULL)
		if (is.null(ssum) || !("Rhat" %in% colnames(ssum))) next
		params <- rownames(ssum)
		rhat_vec <- as.numeric(ssum[, "Rhat"])
		rhat_dfs[[nm]] <- tibble::tibble(Fit = nm, Parameter = params, Rhat = rhat_vec)
	}

	if (length(rhat_dfs) == 0) {
		cat("No Rhat information found in stanfit summaries.\n")
	} else {
		rhat_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(rhat_dfs)

		bad <- rhat_all %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Rhat) & Rhat > 1.05) %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Rhat))
		if (nrow(bad) == 0) {
			cat("All parameters have Rhat <= 1.05\n")
		} else {
			cat("Parameters with Rhat > 1.05:\n")
			print(bad)
		}

		cat("\nTop 10 parameters by Rhat:\n")
		print(utils::head(rhat_all[order(-rhat_all$Rhat), ], 10))

		# Optional: traceplot for the first problematic fit
		if (nrow(bad) > 0) {
			first_fit <- bad$Fit[1]
			problem_params <- unique(bad$Parameter[bad$Fit == first_fit])
			cat('\nTraceplots for', first_fit, ' (up to 10 parameters):\n')
			try(rstan::traceplot(fits[[first_fit]], pars = head(problem_params, 10)), silent = TRUE)
		}
	}
}

```


## 根据switchtype定义新变量并分析
```{r switch_type_beta_setup}
switch_rates_all <- read.csv("Sharing/BKT_participant_rates_by_switchtype.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

switch_beta_df <- switch_rates_all %>%
	transmute(
		id = factor(id),
		FRD = factor(FRD, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("TD", "FRD")),
		current_event = factor(case_when(
			grepl("_to_E_High$", switch_type) ~ "E_High",
			grepl("_to_E_Low$", switch_type) ~ "E_Low",
			TRUE ~ NA_character_
		), levels = c("E_High", "E_Low")),
		switch_status = factor(ifelse(switch_type %in% c("E_High_to_E_High", "E_Low_to_E_Low"), "repeat", "switch"), levels = c("repeat", "switch")),
		learn_mean = as.numeric(learn_mean),
		forget_mean = as.numeric(forget_mean),
		guess_mean = as.numeric(guess_mean),
		slip_mean = as.numeric(slip_mean)
	) %>%
	filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(FRD), !is.na(current_event), !is.na(switch_status), !is.na(learn_mean), !is.na(forget_mean), !is.na(guess_mean), !is.na(slip_mean))

contrasts(switch_beta_df$FRD) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(switch_beta_df$current_event) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(switch_beta_df$switch_status) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)

cat("\nN rows for 3-factor beta GLMM:", nrow(switch_beta_df), "| participants:", dplyr::n_distinct(switch_beta_df$id), "\n")
cat("\nEffect coding for binary predictors (FRD/current_event/switch_status): -1/2, 1/2\n")
```

## Beta-GLMM 数据准备
```{r beta_data_preparation}
beta_adjust <- function(x) {
  pmin(pmax(x, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
}

switch_beta_df <- switch_beta_df %>%
	mutate(
		learn_adj = beta_adjust(learn_mean),
		forget_adj = beta_adjust(forget_mean),
		guess_adj = beta_adjust(guess_mean),
		slip_adj = beta_adjust(slip_mean)
	)

report_apa_beta <- function(model, outcome_name) {
  beta_coef <- summary(model)$coefficients$cond
  beta_ci <- confint(model, parm = "beta_", level = 0.95)
  cat(sprintf("\nAPA summary for %s (Beta GLMM):\n", outcome_name))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(beta_coef))) {
    term_name <- rownames(beta_coef)[i]
    est <- beta_coef[i, "Estimate"]
    p_val <- beta_coef[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    ci_row <- beta_ci[grep(term_name, rownames(beta_ci)), , drop = FALSE]
    if (length(ci_row) == 0L) {
      ci_lower <- NA_real_
      ci_upper <- NA_real_
    } else {
      ci_lower <- as.numeric(ci_row[1, 1])
      ci_upper <- as.numeric(ci_row[1, 2])
    }
    cat(sprintf("%s: B = %.2f, 95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f], p = %.3f.\n",
                term_name, est, ci_lower, ci_upper, p_val))
  }
  print(beta_coef)
}
```

## Learning rate：Beta-GLMM 和事后对比
```{r learn_rate_switch_effects}
model_learn_sw <- glmmTMB(learn_adj ~ FRD * current_event * switch_status + (1 | id),
														 family = beta_family(link = "logit"), data = switch_beta_df)
report_apa_beta(model_learn_sw, "learning rate")

learn_emmean <- emmeans(model_learn_sw, ~ FRD * current_event * switch_status, type = "response")
learn_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_learn_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
learn_contrast_event <- contrast(emmeans(model_learn_sw, ~ FRD | current_event, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
learn_contrast_switch <- contrast(emmeans(model_learn_sw, ~ FRD | switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
learn_contrast_two <- contrast(emmeans(model_learn_sw, ~ switch_status | current_event, type = "response"), method = list("Switch - Repeat" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")

cat("\nLearning - FRD contrasts within each Event condition:\n")
print(summary(learn_contrast_event, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
cat("\nLearning - FRD contrasts within each Switch condition:\n")
print(summary(learn_contrast_switch, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
cat("\nLearning - Switch status contrasts within each Event condition:\n")
print(summary(learn_contrast_two, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
```

## Forgetting rate：Beta-GLMM 和事后对比
```{r forget_rate_switch_effects}
model_forget_sw <- glmmTMB(forget_adj ~ FRD * current_event * switch_status + (1 | id),
							family = beta_family(link = "logit"), data = switch_beta_df)
  report_apa_beta(model_forget_sw, "forgetting rate")

  forget_emmean <- emmeans(model_forget_sw, ~ FRD * current_event * switch_status, type = "response")
	forget_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_forget_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
	forget_contrast_current <- contrast(emmeans(model_forget_sw, ~ FRD | current_event, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")

  cat("\nForgetting - FRD contrasts within each Event x Switch condition:\n")
  print(summary(forget_contrast_frd, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
  cat("\nForgetting - FRD contrasts within each Event condition:\n")
  print(summary(forget_contrast_current, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
```

## Guessing rate：Beta-GLMM 和事后对比
```{r guess_rate_switch_effects}

						   family = beta_family(link = "logit"), data = switch_beta_df)

	guess_contrast_event <- contrast(emmeans(model_guess_sw, ~ switch_status |  current_event, type = "response"), method = list("Switch - Repeat" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")

  print(summary(guess_contrast_frd, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
  cat("\nGuessing - Event contrasts within each Switch condition:\n")
  print(summary(guess_contrast_event, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
  
```

## Slipping rate：Beta-GLMM 和事后对比
```{r slip_rate_switch_effects}
model_slip_sw <- glmmTMB(slip_adj ~ FRD * current_event * switch_status + (1 | id),
						   family = beta_family(link = "logit"), data = switch_beta_df)
  report_apa_beta(model_slip_sw, "slipping rate")

  slip_emmean <- emmeans(model_slip_sw, ~ FRD * current_event * switch_status, type = "response")
	slip_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_slip_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
	slip_contrast_event <- contrast(emmeans(model_slip_sw, ~ switch_status  |  current_event, type = "response"), method = list("Switch - Repeat" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
 
  
  cat("\nSlipping - Event contrasts within each Switch condition:\n")
  print(summary(slip_contrast_event, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
```

```{r plot_switch_type_results}
rate_order <- c("Slipping Rate", "Guessing Rate", "Forgetting Rate", "Learning Rate")
rate_panel_labels <- c("Learning Rate", "Forgetting Rate", "Guessing Rate", "Slipping Rate")
event_order <- c("High", "Low")
switch_order <- c("Repeat", "Switch")

switch_rates_all <- read.csv("Sharing/BKT_participant_rates_by_switchtype.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
	mutate(
		current_event = factor(case_when(
			grepl("_to_E_High$", switch_type) ~ "E_High",
			grepl("_to_E_Low$", switch_type) ~ "E_Low",
			TRUE ~ NA_character_
		), levels = c("E_High", "E_Low"), labels = c("High", "Low")),
		switch_status = factor(ifelse(switch_type %in% c("E_High_to_E_High", "E_Low_to_E_Low"), "repeat", "switch"), levels = c("repeat", "switch"), labels = c("Repeat", "Switch"))
	)

plot_switch_raw <- switch_rates_all %>%
	tidyr::pivot_longer(
		cols = c(learn_mean, forget_mean, guess_mean, slip_mean),
		names_to = "Rate",
		values_to = "value"
	) %>%
	mutate(
		Rate = factor(Rate, levels = c("slip_mean", "guess_mean", "forget_mean", "learn_mean"), labels = c("Slipping Rate", "Guessing Rate", "Forgetting Rate", "Learning Rate")),
		Group = factor(as.character(FRD), levels = c("1", "0"), labels = c("FRD", "TD"))
	) %>%
	filter(!is.na(value))

plot_switch <- switch_rates_all %>%
	group_by(FRD, current_event, switch_status) %>%
	summarise(
		learn_n = sum(!is.na(learn_mean)),
		learn_m = mean(learn_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		learn_sd = sd(learn_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		forget_n = sum(!is.na(forget_mean)),
		forget_m = mean(forget_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		forget_sd = sd(forget_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		guess_n = sum(!is.na(guess_mean)),
		guess_m = mean(guess_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		guess_sd = sd(guess_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		slip_n = sum(!is.na(slip_mean)),
		slip_m = mean(slip_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		slip_sd = sd(slip_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
		.groups = "drop"
	) %>%
	transmute(
		FRD,
		current_event,
		switch_status,
		learn_m,
		learn_se = dplyr::if_else(learn_n > 1, learn_sd / sqrt(learn_n), NA_real_),
		forget_m,
		forget_se = dplyr::if_else(forget_n > 1, forget_sd / sqrt(forget_n), NA_real_),
		guess_m,
		guess_se = dplyr::if_else(guess_n > 1, guess_sd / sqrt(guess_n), NA_real_),
		slip_m,
		slip_se = dplyr::if_else(slip_n > 1, slip_sd / sqrt(slip_n), NA_real_)
	) %>%
	tidyr::pivot_longer(
		cols = c(learn_m, forget_m, guess_m, slip_m, learn_se, forget_se, guess_se, slip_se),
		names_to = c("Rate", ".value"),
		names_pattern = "(learn|forget|guess|slip)_(m|se)"
	) %>%
	mutate(
		Rate = factor(Rate, levels = c("slip", "guess", "forget", "learn"), labels = c("Slipping Rate", "Guessing Rate", "Forgetting Rate", "Learning Rate")),
		Group = factor(as.character(FRD), levels = c("1", "0"), labels = c("FRD", "TD")),
		switch_x = match(as.character(switch_status), switch_order),
		Rate_panel = factor(match(as.character(Rate), rate_panel_labels), levels = 1:4)
	)

stopifnot(identical(levels(plot_switch$Rate), rate_order))

axis_limits <- tidyr::expand_grid(
	Rate = levels(plot_switch$Rate),
	current_event = levels(plot_switch$current_event),
	switch_status = levels(plot_switch$switch_status)
) %>%
	mutate(
		ymax = case_when(
			Rate == "Learning Rate" ~ 0.80,
			Rate == "Forgetting Rate" ~ 0.35,
			Rate == "Guessing Rate" ~ 0.16,
			Rate == "Slipping Rate" ~ 0.06,
			TRUE ~ 1
		),
		Rate_panel = factor(match(as.character(Rate), rate_panel_labels), levels = 1:4)
	)

learn_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_learn_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
forget_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_forget_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
guess_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_guess_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")
slip_contrast_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_slip_sw, ~ FRD | current_event * switch_status, type = "response"), method = list("FRD - TD" = c(-1, 1)), adjust = "bonferroni")

posthoc_switch <- bind_rows(
		as.data.frame(learn_contrast_frd) %>% transmute(Rate = "Learning Rate", current_event, switch_status, p.value),
		as.data.frame(forget_contrast_frd) %>% transmute(Rate = "Forgetting Rate", current_event, switch_status, p.value),
		as.data.frame(guess_contrast_frd) %>% transmute(Rate = "Guessing Rate", current_event, switch_status, p.value),
		as.data.frame(slip_contrast_frd) %>% transmute(Rate = "Slipping Rate", current_event, switch_status, p.value)
	) %>%
	mutate(
		current_event = recode(as.character(current_event), E_High = "High", E_Low = "Low"),
		switch_status = recode(as.character(switch_status), `repeat` = "Repeat", `switch` = "Switch"),
		star_label = case_when(
			!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
			!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
			!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
			TRUE ~ ""
		)
	) %>%
	filter(star_label != "") %>%
	mutate(
		Rate = factor(Rate, levels = rate_order),
		current_event = factor(current_event, levels = event_order),
		switch_status = factor(switch_status, levels = switch_order),
		switch_x = match(as.character(switch_status), switch_order),
		Rate_panel = factor(match(as.character(Rate), rate_panel_labels), levels = 1:4)
	) %>%
	left_join(
		plot_switch %>% group_by(current_event, switch_status, Rate) %>% summarise(y = max(m + se, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
		by = c("current_event", "switch_status", "Rate")
	) %>%
	left_join(axis_limits %>% distinct(Rate, ymax), by = "Rate") %>%
	mutate(
		switch_x = match(as.character(switch_status), switch_order),
		plot_ymax = ifelse(Rate == "Slipping Rate", 0.06, ymax),
		bracket_y = plot_ymax * 0.95,
		bracket_yend = plot_ymax * 0.93,
		star_y = plot_ymax * 0.95,
		x_left = switch_x - 0.32,
		x_right = switch_x + 0.32
	)

slip_event_sig <- as.data.frame(slip_contrast_event) %>%
	transmute(
		Rate = "Slipping Rate",
		current_event,
		p.value
	) %>%
	mutate(
		current_event = recode(as.character(current_event), E_High = "High", E_Low = "Low"),
		star_label = case_when(
			!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
			!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
			!is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
			TRUE ~ ""
		),
		current_event = factor(current_event, levels = event_order),
		plot_ymax = 0.06,
		bracket_y = plot_ymax * 0.95,
		bracket_yend = plot_ymax * 0.93,
		star_y = plot_ymax * 0.95,
		x_left = 1 - 0.32,
		x_right = 2 + 0.32
	) %>%
	filter(star_label != "")

plot_switch <- plot_switch %>%
	mutate(
		Rate = factor(Rate, levels = c("Learning Rate", "Forgetting Rate", "Guessing Rate", "Slipping Rate")),
		current_event = factor(current_event, levels = event_order),
		switch_status = factor(switch_status, levels = switch_order)
	)

axis_limits <- axis_limits %>%
	mutate(
		Rate = factor(Rate, levels = c("Learning Rate", "Forgetting Rate", "Guessing Rate", "Slipping Rate"))
	)

plot_switch <- plot_switch %>%
	mutate(
		condition = interaction(current_event, switch_status, sep = "\n"),
		condition = factor(
			condition,
			levels = c("High\nRepeat", "High\nSwitch", "Low\nRepeat", "Low\nSwitch")
		)
	)

axis_limits <- axis_limits %>%
	mutate(
		condition = interaction(current_event, switch_status, sep = "\n"),
		condition = factor(
			condition,
			levels = c("High\nRepeat", "High\nSwitch", "Low\nRepeat", "Low\nSwitch")
		)
	)

rate_levels <- levels(plot_switch$Rate)

if (!dir.exists("figures")) dir.create("figures", recursive = TRUE)

for (rate_name in rate_levels) {
	plot_rate_raw <- plot_switch_raw %>%
		filter(Rate == rate_name)

	plot_rate <- plot_switch %>%
		filter(Rate == rate_name, !is.na(m), !is.na(se))
	
	axis_rate <- axis_limits %>%
		filter(Rate == rate_name, !is.na(ymax))
	
	p_rate <- ggplot(plot_rate, aes(x = switch_status, y = m, fill = Group)) +
		facet_grid(. ~ current_event) +
		geom_violin(
			data = plot_rate_raw,
			aes(x = switch_status, y = value, fill = Group, group = interaction(switch_status, Group)),
			position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
			width = 0.75,
			trim = FALSE,
			scale = "width",
			color = "black",
			alpha = 0.65,
			na.rm = TRUE
		) +
		geom_point(
			data = plot_rate_raw,
			aes(x = switch_status, y = value, fill = Group, group = interaction(switch_status, Group)),
			position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.8),
			size = 1.2,
			alpha = 0.35,
			color = "grey60",
			na.rm = TRUE,
			show.legend = FALSE
		) +
		stat_summary(
			data = plot_rate_raw,
			aes(x = switch_status, y = value, group = interaction(switch_status, Group)),
			fun = mean,
			geom = "point",
			position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
			shape = 23,
			size = 2.2,
			fill = "white",
			color = "black",
			show.legend = FALSE
		) +
		geom_blank(
			data = axis_rate,
			aes(x = switch_status, y = ymax),
			inherit.aes = FALSE
		) +
		scale_fill_manual(
			values = c("TD" = "#ffffff", "FRD" = "#504d4d"),
			breaks = c("TD", "FRD")
		) +
		scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Repeat", "Switch")) +
		scale_y_continuous(
			expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
			limits = if (rate_name == "Slipping Rate") c(0.02, NA) else if (rate_name == "Guessing Rate") c(0.04, 0.16) else c(0, 1),
			oob = scales::oob_squish,
			labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
			breaks = waiver()
		) +
		labs(
			x = "Transition Type",
			y = "Posterior mean",
			title = rate_name
		) +
		plot_theme +
		theme(
			axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "black"),
			axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
			axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
			plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
			strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "#000000", linewidth = 0.8),
			strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
			panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
			panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
			panel.grid = element_blank(),
			legend.position = "right",
			legend.justification = "center",
			legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85), color = NA),
			legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
			legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
			panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.8, "lines"),
			panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
			plot.margin = margin(20, 10, 10, 10)
		) +
		coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
	
	print(p_rate)
	file_name <- paste0("N_BKT_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(rate_name)), "_violin.tif")
	ggsave(file.path("figures", file_name), p_rate, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300, device = "tiff", compression = "lzw")
}
```

```{r notes}
# If fitting is slow, try:
# 1) iter = 1000 (warmup = 500) for a first pass.
# 2) Use fewer participants as a test subset.
# 3) Install cmdstanr later for faster compilation/sampling.
# 4) If convergence is still poor, fix guess/slip as constants (e.g., 0.10) to reduce identifiability issues.
```
